summary: Franklin Electric's wholly owned subsidiary FE Force, LLC closed the purchase of all outstanding stock of Cat Pumps Corporation from its shareholders on September 4, 2026, per an 8-K filed September 8, 2026. Consideration comprised roughly $350 million cash, subject to adjustment, plus performance restricted stock units with a $25 million target value tied to 2028 gross profit thresholds, payable 0% to 200%. Cash was funded from available cash and existing credit facilities. The PRSUs were issued under a Section 4(a)(2) private-placement exemption. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch integration execution, purchase-price adjustments, and PRSU milestone risk.
